summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of NaukariGPT.com Next.js frontend. All core features are working correctly including navigation, search, category pages, post details, subscribe popup, chat widget, social sharing, SEO endpoints, and responsive design. The app is production-ready with only one minor UX issue identified.

minor_ux_issues.issue: Subscribe modal does NOT reappear on navigation after being dismissed (spec indicates it should reappear on next page navigation)
minor_ux_issues.note: Modal appears correctly after 12s delay, dismiss sets localStorage, and after subscribe it correctly doesn't reappear. Only the reappear-after-dismiss-on-navigation behavior is not working as specified.

passed_tests: Home page loads with HTTP 200 and displays hero, ticker, category bento, latest feed, trending sidebar, and popular tools list
TopNav logo click returns to home page
TopNav category links (Notifications, Jobs, Admit Card, Results, Admission, Scholarships) navigate correctly
TopNav 'More' dropdown shows Answer Key, Tools, Guides and navigates correctly
TopNav search input shows dropdown suggestions and Enter key navigates to first match
Mobile menu (hamburger) opens sheet with all 9 categories and static pages
All 9 category pages return HTTP 200 with breadcrumb and posts grid
Post detail page shows title, badges, Important Dates table, Eligibility/Age/Fee info, Apply Online button, Official Notification link, and 'More in' related posts section
Social share bar visible with WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and Copy buttons
Copy link button triggers toast notification
Subscribe popup appears 12 seconds after page load with Telegram and WhatsApp buttons
Subscribe popup does NOT appear immediately (correct 12s delay)
Dismissing subscribe modal sets localStorage 'ngpt_subscribe_dismissed' to true
Clicking Telegram/WhatsApp in subscribe modal sets localStorage 'ngpt_subscribed' to true and modal closes
After subscribing, modal does NOT reappear on navigation or reload (correct behavior)
Chat widget button opens panel with input and send button
Chat widget search returns clickable result links and navigates to posts
Static pages (/about, /privacy-policy, /disclaimer, /terms, /report-bug) return HTTP 200 with proper headings
Report Bug form has email, description, and submit fields with validation
/robots.txt returns HTTP 200 with Sitemap reference
/sitemap.xml returns HTTP 200 with 87 URL entries
Home page contains Organization/WebSite JSON-LD structured data
Post detail page contains Article JSON-LD structured data
Job post detail contains JobPosting JSON-LD structured data
Mobile viewport (390x844) renders correctly with visible hamburger menu
Tablet viewport (768x1024) renders correctly
Desktop viewport (1440x900) renders correctly
Sticky mobile apply bar visible at bottom of post pages on mobile viewport
No critical JavaScript console errors (only expected dev-mode warnings)
action_item_for_main_agent: Optional: Fix subscribe modal reappear-on-navigation behavior in /app/frontend/src/components/site/SubscribeModal.jsx (lines 70-80). The modal should reappear on route navigation after being dismissed, but currently does not. This is a minor UX issue and does not block production deployment.
